༄༅/ /grol tig dgongs pa rang grol las/dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul gyi smin byed gsang ba gcig grub mtshams sbyor gyis brgyan pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// grol tig dgongs pa rang grol las/ dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul gyi smin byed gsang ba gcig grub mtshams sbyor gyis brgyan pa bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru ha ya grī bā ya/ 'khor 'das bde ba chen po'i thig ler rdzogs// thugs rje'i rang gzugs phyag rgyar khros pa'i lha// sa gsum dregs pa 'dul mdzad der btud nas// 'jug bde'i dbang dang mtshams sbyor sbrel ma dgod// de la sbyor ba maṇ+ḍal steng tshom bu dmar po gcig bkod pa'i khar/ mañdzi la dpal gtor rgyan gyis spras pa/ g.yas su rnam bum bcud ldan/ g.yon du thod chang khar me long gsal bas bkab/ sman raka gtor gsum phyi mchod bskor bsham bya/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang las bum sogs nyer mkho 'du bya/ dngos gzhi'i thog mar bgegs gtor gtang na thugs chen pad+ma'i dbang phyug nas len/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs spyi 'gro byas la/ mdun bskyed mchod pa rdzogs kyi bar btang la dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du bcas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ bum bzlas zur du spro na spyi ltar gsal btab la snying po bzla/ las bum rta sngags spyi 'gres byin brlabs mthar las gzhung gi gtor 'bul dang bstod pa bya zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blangs la gnang ba nod do// de nas dbang bskur dngos la/ slob ma khrus nas dbyung*/ bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom/ sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de'ang rgyal ba ma lus pa'i gsung rdo rje'i bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug drag por khros pa'i tshul bstan pa/ rta skad thengs gsum gyi dgongs pas 'khor 'das ma lus pa dbang du sdud cing zil gyis gnon par mdzad pa'i dpal chen po rta mchog he ru ka la/ gdul bya'i yul dang mthun pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur mang zhing de dang mthun pa'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs mtha' yas pa byon pa las/ bdud dang dam sri gdug pa can 'dul ba'i gnyen po stobs kyi lha mchog rta mgrin dregs pa kun 'dul gyi gdams skor chos rgyal srong btsan lugs sogs 'ga' zhig byon pa las/

khyad par du 'phags pa tshe dpag med dngos pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs tig bskyed rdzogs 'khrul med tsit+ta dmar po'i skor 'di ni/ rang gzhung las/ de ltar dbang chen rig pa'i dbang bskur thabs: rang gi mig dang snying las phangs gyur kyang: ma 'ongs snyigs ma bzhi bcu kha ral dus: dam sri sde brgyad rdul du brlag pa la: ches zab pad+ma'i snying khrag dam pa 'di: 'gro ba mchog dman su yis nyams blangs kyang: phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar nges: rtag tu mi 'bral 'chang ba'i chos mchog 'di: bzang ngan 'brel tshad thugs rje'i smon lam gyis: bde chen gnas su khrid pa de la sprod: ces gtad rgya dang bcas te grogs ri rin chen spungs par gter du sbas pa/ lo chen bai ro'i thugs sprul 'od gsal sna tshogs rang grol gyis spyan drangs pa ste/ de nyid kyi smin byed rtsa ba'i dbang bzhi bsgrub pa la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul gzhug / ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis me tog sbyin/ thal mo me tog dang ldan pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye: 'gro ba'i mgon po ston pa bla na med: bde gshegs kun 'dus bdag la dgongs su gsol: ma rig las kyis mnar ba'i sems can la: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang mchog bskur du gsol: lan gsum/ bla mas/ kye: skal ldan rigs kyi bu gcig bdag la gson: gsang ba'i mchog 'di rab tu gnyan pas na: mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig srung nus sam: de ltar khas blangs bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin: ji ltar bsgos pa las 'da' bar mi bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ sa ma ya i dan te na ra kan: zhes bdud rtsi blud/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal chen rta mchog dregs pa kun 'dul la rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgya mtshos sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bskor te bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ skyabs gsol sngon du 'gro ba can gyi smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed blang ba 'di'i rjes zlos/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags: 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang: sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir: byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi: byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas: sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer: byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi: 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog: ces lan gsum/ de nas ye shes pa dbab par gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye ho: bla ma bde gshegs rgyal ba thams cad kyi: byin rlabs ye shes bdag la dbab tu gsol: lan gsum/ de la sgo gsum gyi gnad legs par gcun te dmigs pa 'di bzhin du sgoms mdzod/ rtsa sngags dang las chus bsang*/ shūn+ya tā sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi rig pa'i ngo bo hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las skad cig gis dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul sku mdog dmar po shin tu khros pa'i rnam 'gyur rdzogs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i be con nam mkhar phyar zhing g.yon pas rdo rje'i tho ba me rab tu 'bar ba bsnams pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa'i gseb nas rta mgo ljang zhur 'tsher ba/ thod pa'i phreng ba sogs dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan cing zhabs 'dor stabs kyis sbyor ging bsnol ba'i gdan la 'gying ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng na hrīḥdamar po gsal ba dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer glog dmar gyi zhags pa lta bu 'phros pas ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te thim par sgoms shig / spos rol bcas/

hrī: lho nub dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas: khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dbang gi lha: bde gshegs khro bo'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: thugs rjes brtser dgongs gnas 'dir byin phob cig: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: zhes dbab la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa brtan par bya/ sngar byin pa'i me tog lhag pa'i lha la 'bul ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ puṣ+pe sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes dor gzhug / lhag pa'i lha dbang rtags cod pan dang gnyis su med pa spyi bor bcings par mos/ puṣ+pe a bhi ṣiñtsa: zhes me tog spyi bor bzhag /'bru gsum gyis gdong bsal/ ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs bsal bas dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul gyi dkyil 'khor gnyan po mngon sum du mjal bar mos shig /de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos rnams song nas/ dbang bzhi rim par bskur ba'i dang po bum chu rdo rje'i ye shes chen po'i rgyun gyis lus la bum pa'i dbang bskur bar mos shig / rnam bum gyis dbang bskur cing bum chu sbyin la/ hrī: dag byed ye shes bdud rtsi lha yi chu: bde gshegs dbang chen 'dus pa'i bum pa yis: skal ldan dbang bskur dbang bzhi'i snod gyur cig: hrīḥka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des lus kyi sgrib pa dag /bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang ba yin pas/ snod bcud thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor ye nas yin par shes pas snang stong bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson par gyis shig dang*/ sku rdo rje mngon du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ gnyis pa bdud rtsi byang sems bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyis ngag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur bar mos shig / thod pa mgrin par gtugs/ bdud rtsi sbyin la/ hrī: chos sku snang mtha'i ngang nas ma g.yos kyang: longs spyod rdzogs sku snang tshul cir yang ston: sprul sku khro rgyal rta mgrin dbang gi lha: kun 'dus byang sems bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ro: hrīḥbo dhi tsit+ta a mṛta wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

des ngag gi sgrib pa dag /bzlas brjod dang mtshan bcas rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pas/ sgra grags thams cad rdo rje sngags kyi rang sgra ye nas yin par shes pas grags stong bzlas pa'i rim pa dang bdag byin rlabs kyi rnal 'byor la brtson par mdzod dang*/ gsung rdo rje mngon du 'grub par 'gyur ro// gsum pa me long bde 'jam gyi reg bya gsal la stong pa'i rang bzhin can gyis sems la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bar mos shig / me long snying gar gtugs/ lag tu gtad la/ hrī: reg bya'i bde ba 'jam zhing yid du 'ong: stong gsal mnyam yangs ye shes gsal 'grib med: sna tshogs 'char ba shes rab dbang mchog 'di: skal ldan gsang sngags dam pas dbang bskur ro: hrīḥkarma mu dra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des yid kyi sgrib pa dag /bde stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i thabs lam bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pas/ rtog tshogs thams cad bde chen byang chub sems kyi rol par ye nas yin par shes pas/ rig stong thabs shes dbyings ye zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor la brtson par mdzod dang*/ thugs rdo rje mngon du 'grub par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa ye shes chen po'i snod bcud yongs su rdzogs pa dpal gyi gtor mas sgo gsum la bzhi pa rig rtsal gyi dbang bskur bar mos shig / gtor ma gnas gsum du bzhag la/ hrī: snod bcud rnam dag rten dang brten par bcas: rang lus phung khams dang bcas gzhal yas khang: don dam rig stong 'gyur med bzhi pa'i dbang: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: hrīḥti la ka dz+nyā na ba lin+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des 'pho ba'i sgrib pa dag /'od gsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pas/ snang srid rdzogs pa chen po'i rang bzhin ye nas yin par shes pas gnas lugs ngang bzhag dang mngon sum snang ba zung 'brel gyi rnal 'byor la brtson par mdzod dang*/ ye shes rdo rje mngon du 'grub par 'gyur ro//

bka' srung rdo rje gshog rgod ma'i srog dbang brgyud 'dzin lta bur 'di dang rjes 'brel du bya/ de nas shis pa brjod/ dbang rjes rnams spyi ltar bya/ slob dpon gyis tshogs byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul bstab dang*/ tshogs la rol cing lhag ma brtan skyong rta bro'i bar du btang*/ dkyil 'khor pa la gtang rag mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ mdun bskyed gshegs bstim rten dang bstun/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon shis brjod rigs mthun nas blang ba'am spyi 'gre bya'o// dbang gi phyag rgyas snang sems ro mnyam btab// bde chen thig ler srid zhi gcig tu bsdams// rta mchog dpal gyi sku dang ye shes su// lus can thams cad mngon byang chub par shog /ces rin po che gter gyi mdzod chen por chos sde'i cha lag rdzogs pa'i ched du rang nyid kyi 'dod 'jor pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang las dbang chen rol pa'i gnas su bris pa dge legs 'phel// //
